provenance.movement_reasoning: Nadia’s overnight work makes the entry, dining chair, counter, and nightstand the main landing zones. Trip essentials leave with her and return to their habitual homes; food containers are packed before work and rinsed afterward. Quiet decompression moves tea, screens, remote, headphones, and reading material around the sofa and bed. Dishes reliably progress through sink and drying rack, while laundry, bathing, medication, and periodic cleaning reset bedroom and bathroom objects.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A solitary hospital laboratory technician who protects daytime sleep, keeps a compact one-bedroom apartment dim and orderly, and uses a few repeatable departure and wind-down rituals rather than a conventional daytime routine.
